title: Set up an amigo secreto
summary: The organiser sets up an amigo secreto in a group: name, exchange day, price limit, who takes part (members and people not on Bipe yet), and pairs that may not draw each other. The organiser shares the group link, calls the people still missing, and draws.

slotId.description: A random id for the slot.

name.description: The display name the organiser typed, at most inviteeNameMaxGraphemes.

claimedBy.description: The user ID that claimed the slot with claimSlot on the card. Empty until then.

first.description: A participant user ID or invitee slotId.

second.description: Another participant user ID or invitee slotId.

roomId.description: The group. Empty when the organiser starts from the Grupos tab with no group yet; createGroup makes one.

setupId.description: A random id, the same in every setup event of this amigo secreto.

name.description: Starts as bipe_amigo_secreto_name_default with the year of the exchange day.

exchangeDate.description: The exchange day. Also the day drawWithJoined is offered.

priceLimitCents.description: In BRL cents, at most priceLimitMaxCents. Empty: bipe_amigo_secreto_price_limit_none.

participants.description: Members who take part. Starts with every joined member of the group.

of.description: A person not on Bipe yet.

exclusions.description: Pairs that may not draw each other, both ways.

problem.description: checkAmigoSecretoSetup on participants plus claimed invitees. Shown under the list with the matching bipe_amigo_secreto_error_* string.

groupLink.description: The group link (group-link spec, ADR 0184) used by share and call.

drawing.description: true while the results go out.

createGroup.effect: Only when roomId is empty: creates a group named after name, makes its group link, then publishes the setup. The organiser is the admin.

setName.effect: Updates name. Text checks of security rule 8 (homoglyphs, reserved names).

setExchangeDate.effect: Updates exchangeDate. Not in the past.

toggleParticipant.effect: Adds or removes the member and the exclusions that name them.

addInvitee.effect: Adds an invitee slot. The organiser may pick the name from the address book; the phone number stays on this phone and never goes into an event.

removeInvitee.effect: Removes the slot and its exclusions.

publish.effect: Sends the setup as an encrypted setupEventType event in the group with Room.sendRaw. Sent after every change that the group should see; the newest event with this setupId wins.

share.effect: Opens the share sheet with bipe_amigo_secreto_share_message (organiser name, amigo secreto name, group link). The text is in the person voice (pra).

call.effect: Opens the share sheet with bipe_amigo_secreto_call_message and the group link, aimed at that person when the organiser picked them from the address book. Nothing leaves the phone before the organiser sends it.

draw.effect: Only when problem is none and every invitee slot is claimed. drawAmigoSecreto with a secure random source; makes a wishKey (wishKeyBytes) and a wishTag (wishTagBytes) per participant; sends each participant one encrypted to-device resultEventType message; publishes state drawn; deletes the pairs, keys and tags from this phone. On a failed send shows bipe_amigo_secreto_error_send and retries only the failed ones from the pairs it still holds.

drawWithJoined.effect: From exchangeDate, or earlier after a confirm with bipe_amigo_secreto_draw_with_joined_body: drops the unclaimed slots and their exclusions, then draw.

redraw.effect: Only in state drawn and before exchangeDate: a new draw with a new round number. Every card shows bipe_amigo_secreto_redrawn and the old result goes.

cancel.effect: Publishes state cancelled. Every card shows bipe_amigo_secreto_cancelled.

notes: Rules and limits: registries/amigo-secreto.json and tools/lib/amigo-secreto.mjs. The apps pass test-vectors/amigo-secreto.json and draw with a secure random source.
No server logic and no server state. Bipe never learns the pairs. The organiser's phone holds the pairs only until every result is sent.
Open item for the build: whether matrix-sdk-ffi exposes an encrypted to-device send. A spike confirms it first. A result in a room event is not allowed: the organiser could read it later.
The duplicate problem cannot come from this UI; the check is there for events from other clients.
Entry points: the group menu in group-details, and bipe_amigo_secreto_create on the Grupos tab (createGroup).
The anonymous hint (dica) from bipe-chat/bipe#1527 step 4 is not here. It waits for MZ (ADR 0247).
Groups with a member under 18: the feature works the same. Invitee names are display names only.
